station.unsupported: this version of KyberNow Station can’t do this: update it from Admin

wake.no_target: the computer’s network card is unknown: the app learns it from KyberNow Station (0.5.0 or later) while the computer is on
wake.network: no wake-up packet could be sent ({error})

session.no_image: the computer is not sending a picture (its encoder is not responding: see its log in Admin, System › Logs)
session.unauthorized: the computer's Kyber server does not recognise this device's account yet: in Admin, restart the Station (System), then try again
session.tls: the certificate of the computer's Kyber server does not match the one given by Admin
session.image_refused: the computer rejected the picture request
session.not_responding: the computer is no longer responding
session.no_display: no usable display on the computer
session.station_not_back: the Station is taking a while to come back after restarting: open Admin to find out more

update.other_key: manifest signed with a key other than KyberNow's
update.invalid_signature: invalid manifest signature: tampered or damaged version
update.version_mismatch: the signed manifest announces {manifest} but GitHub publishes {version}
update.file_missing: {file} is missing from the signed manifest of version {version}
update.tampered: downloaded file differs from the signed manifest: damaged or tampered with

share.unsupported: Sharing needs KyberNow Station 0.8.0 or later.
share.disabled: Sharing is turned off on this computer (Admin › Link devices).
share.no_share: No share with this code on your network.
share.full: This share is full (four guests at most).
share.too_many: Too many code attempts: try again in a minute.
share.unreadable: This device cannot play this computer's picture ({format}).
share.no_kyber_fingerprint: the computer did not give its Kyber server's fingerprint: update KyberNow Station
share.display_missing: the shared display is no longer on the computer
share.unauthorized: the computer refuses the share's token: join again with the code
share.lost: the share is no longer answering
share.image_limit: The computer can't make another picture: you get {quality}.
share.pending_full: Too many requests waiting: try again in a moment.

relay.offline: The computer cannot be reached: it is off or asleep.
relay.offline_named: {name} cannot be reached: the computer is off or asleep.
relay.access_off: Access away from home is turned off in Admin.
relay.access_off_named: {name} cannot be reached away from home (access turned off in Admin).
relay.no_fingerprint: through the relay, the computer's fingerprint is needed: pair this device on the computer's network
relay.fingerprint_mismatch: the computer's fingerprint given by the relay is not the one this device knows
